# Season Shelf 1.2.11

- Fixed Recent series reopening: entries now read the exact saved Telegram message and display its current text and buttons, just like pasting its message link.
- Bot edits during season and quality navigation no longer force another group search. Use the existing message's Back button to choose another season while that message remains available.
- Quality menus opened directly from a message link are remembered, even when their season selector was never opened in the app.
- Existing 1.2.10 entries retain their saved message references. Reopening an entry does not start a bot, request another delivery or post a search.

Deleted, inaccessible or genuinely expired messages still offer a fresh-search recovery path. Downloaded files and account data are preserved.
